source.name: Sola Busca
source.note: Earliest fully-illustrated 78-card tarot (Italy, c.1491). Trumps 00-21, pips/courts 22-77; non-standard imagery.

source.name: Tarot Nouveau
source.note: French-suited game tarot (Grimaud, 1898), BnF scans. Trumps 01-21 are genre scenes, 00 is the Excuse; suits Hearts/Diamonds/Clubs/Spades.

source.name: Tarot de Viéville
source.note: Jacques Viéville's tarot (Paris, c.1650), BnF scans. Printed trump order differs from Marseille: VII Justice, VIII Chariot, IX Force, XI Hermit.

m15.jpg.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: a single tarot card illustration for an offline tarot app. Create a NEW modern interpretive reconstruction inspired by the public-domain fifteenth-century Visconti–Sforza cards, not a claim to depict a surviving original. Portrait aspect ratio 1:2. Flat straight-on scan of the entire card, filling the image, thin aged ivory outer margins and thin dark blue rectangular inner rule. Lombard early Renaissance tempera miniature on old parchment, delicately tooled antique gold leaf, worn pigments of muted ultramarine, vermilion and moss green, fine brown linework, shallow space, elegant elongated courtly forms, restrained detail and naturally irregular paint. Match an antique Visconti–Sforza deck rather than Rider–Waite. No writing, lettering, numbers, labels, modern elements, extra border outside the card, watermark, 3D mockup, hands holding card, or photographic setting. Subject: THE DEVIL. A single full-length folkloric horned devil with small bat wings, clawed feet and a long curling tail, standing on a small low plinth, one hand raised and the other holding a short staff. A medieval allegorical creature, austere rather than horror, against a tooled gold background with a narrow green earth strip. No chained people and no nudity.
m15.jpg.note: Ilustração nova inspirada no Visconti–Sforza; não reproduz uma carta histórica preservada.

Subject: THREE OF SWORDS, a non-scenic suit card. Exactly THREE slender Renaissance swords, two outer curved blades symmetrically facing inward, one straight sword upright at center, dark blue steel, delicate red and gilt hilts. Arrange three swords elegantly on aged ivory parchment with a few small red, blue and green botanical tendrils, as a Visconti minor pip card. No heart, people, landscape or additional weapons. The count MUST be exactly three swords.
